detailed_descriptions.en: SECRETS OF THE MYSTERIOUS ISLAND A cryptic message from your missing father leads you to a remote island shrouded in dark secrets. Once the site of secret experiments, the island is now haunted each night by a strange, mystical beam that reactivates abandoned electronics and awakens monstrous creatures. What really happened here? And what part did your father play in it all? The answers may be closer than you think… SURVIVE AT ANY COST Explore a vast and perilous island, scavenging for food, fuel, medicine, and ammunition. Be ready to fight for your life against aggressive zombies and equally dangerous survivors. Build, fortify, and defend your shelter, craft weapons, and prepare to face each night fully armed. THE FARM — YOUR NEW HOME Once abandoned, your father's old farm has become your refuge and workshop. Restore and upgrade it, grow supplies to weather the island’s hardships. Turn it into a cozy, reliable home — a safe haven from the dangers beyond its fences. YOUR VEHICLE — YOUR GREATEST ALLY Your car is the cornerstone of survival and the key to exploring the island. Haul resources, building materials, and loot; deliver logs to the sawmill and bring supplies back to the farm. Upgrade and customize it to enhance power, durability, and looks. Just don’t forget to refuel — or you might find yourself stranded when you need it most. WHEN NIGHT FALLS… As the sun sets, the island transforms. A mysterious night-time beam reactivates old machinery — giving you the chance to refuel at deserted stations, smelt scrap, or access previously sealed bunkers. But beware: with the machines come the island’s mutated creatures, awakened and ready to tear apart anything in their path. HUMANITY’S LAST HOPE Uncover the dark truths of Outbreak Island — and perhaps you’ll become the last hope to save humanity from a looming catastrophe.
